metadata.schema_version: v2 (sampled Tb + sampled core + derived rho_sil)
metadata.description: Phase C1 BodyConfig: Ganymede with pure H2O ocean and Andrade rheology. HP ice shell present (Ice III/V/VI locked together via param_groups). 8D problem.
metadata.primary_constraint: CMR2 from Schubert et al. (2004), Jupiter system chapter
metadata.k2_status: NOT INCLUDED - no published k2 measurement for Ganymede. JUICE will provide constraints (~2034). Add to observables once available.
metadata.Tb_bounds_rationale: Lower bound 252.2 K = TtripleIh_III_L_K + 1 K (approaches but does not cross the no-ocean limit). Upper bound 261.0 K is preliminary, targeting ~50 km Ih shell at the thin end. Refine in Stage 3 by running PP at the boundary Tb values. Default PP Tb=258.86 K sits inside the range.
metadata.core_bounds_rationale: R_core in [0, 0.5 R_body] permits the no-core limit; rho_core in [5000, 8000] kg/m^3 brackets metallic Fe / Fe-S compositions. rho_sil is derived from M_total mass conservation given the cached ice+ocean profile and sampled core; samples with rho_sil outside [2200, 3500] kg/m^3 are rejected by the likelihood.
metadata.next_step_after_C1: Per-composition runs by adding 0.1 molal increments of NaCl to the ocean using the SeaFreeze NaCl representation (deferred - not part of Phase C1).
metadata.stage2_dependencies: Toolkit must (a) parse the derived_params block, (b) implement the rho_sil mass-conservation solver and rejection, (c) extend the structure cache to include M_ice_kg / M_ocean_kg / R_oceanbot_m / M_total_kg per Tb point, (d) recompute CMR2 from the sampled core + derived rho_sil + cached ice/ocean profile.
metadata.stage3_dependencies: Build Tb-grid structure cache for Ganymede with pure H2O ocean across the sampled Tb range.
